metadata.title: From Fold to Physics: An Exact, Parameter-Free and Machine-Closed Reconstruction of Physical Science from Smithian Fold Theory
metadata.description:
From Fold to Physics, version 1.1 is an unpublished corrected and expanded draft covering the 285 claims currently registered to Physics and carrying immutable model-admitted receipts. It does not yet certify that those claims exhaust every Physics-owned atomic obligation in V1/V2; the complete one-owner source decomposition remains open and blocks publication.

The draft preserves 172,016 explicitly generated candidates, 172,016 one-for-one decisions, 285 unique survivors and 1,140 passing adverse controls. Candidate grammars use their actual declared cardinalities rather than one repeated template. All included derivations are documented with root dependencies, exact theorem statements, candidate generators, closure boundaries, survivor identities, local uniqueness witnesses, controls, independent reconstruction hashes, empirical custody where registered and engine receipts.

Headline results include generator three, three-dimensional Fold stability, rank-two boundary support, inverse-square dilution, the terminal exact inverse fine-structure relation and its post-seal CODATA comparison, physical constants and scale relations, vacuum structure and extraction limits, force sectors, quantum and relativistic correspondence, matter and flavour, atomic and molecular precision successors, nuclear and hadronic structure, gravitational exterior and radiated-power laws, and the strong self-source fixed-point boundary.

The draft must not be published until the V1/V2 atomic ownership audit proves zero Physics-owned omissions.
